clusters.objective: Keep household pets fed and watered without continuous human attention.
clusters.meaningful_failure: care_lapse: pet left without water or food
clusters.authorized_action_scope: fill water bowl; activate food dispenser and fountain when pet presence detected
clusters.rationale: Two independent demand owners (user-02 dog watering, user-20 cat feeding) converge on maintained pet provisioning, but all evidence sits in one study cluster and is hypothetical/not deployed; needs >=3 owners in one cluster for candidate_needs_confirmation and >=2 study clusters for convergent admission.
clusters.boundary_notes: Merged across species (dog/cat) since maintained outcome is identical: animal hydration/nutrition. Not merged with plant watering (u20_r117): different beneficiary (living pet vs household plant) and different failure meaning. The camera-arming conjunct of u02_r009 is split into away_security_monitoring, not jointly managed here.
coding_disagreements: u20_r118 beneficiary: luna=household, kimi=third_party; luna assigns failure_meaning=care_lapse, kimi=unknown; luna leaves candidate_responsibility null while kimi names one for u02_r009

clusters.objective: Keep the home monitored while the household is away.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: turn on security cameras when no one is home
clusters.rationale: Single hypothetical rule from a single owner in a single study cluster; no direct-path rating (both coders compatible_only) and no convergence.
clusters.boundary_notes: Split from the pet-watering conjunct in the same rule; security monitoring and pet care are distinct maintained outcomes. Kept separate from away_visitor_notification (u02_r010): security monitoring vs personal awareness of visitors, though a broader 'away awareness' merge is defensible.
coding_disagreements: luna assigns failure_meaning=security_failure, kimi=unknown; luna candidate_responsibility null vs kimi names one

clusters.objective: Keep the absent user informed of intercom visitors.
clusters.meaningful_failure: missed visitor or delivery with no notification
clusters.authorized_action_scope: send message to user's phone when intercom rings and nobody is home
clusters.rationale: Single hypothetical rule, single owner, single study cluster; no explicit failure meaning in text; both coders rate compatible_only.
clusters.boundary_notes: Adjacent to away_home_security_monitoring but not merged: visitor notification is communication/awareness, not intrusion monitoring; different authorized action (notify vs activate cameras).

clusters.objective: Maintain lighting and device ambiance matched to the current leisure activity.
clusters.meaningful_failure: discomfort or degraded activity experience (glare during music, lights on during movie, phone ringing mid-film)
clusters.authorized_action_scope: decrease lounge light brightness during music; turn off room lights and silence phone during movie projection
clusters.rationale: Two rules converge on activity-matched ambiance but originate from a single independence unit (user-02) in one study cluster; hypothetical only.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with vr_play_session_boundaries (u02_r012): VR rule is about containing interruption and limiting play duration, not ambiance. Luna assigns failure_meaning=discomfort only to r008.
coding_disagreements: r008 failure_meaning: luna=discomfort, kimi=unknown; kimi names candidate_responsibility for r008 while luna leaves both null

clusters.objective: Contain interruptions and bound duration of immersive VR/console play sessions.
clusters.meaningful_failure: overlong unbroken play session or external interruption of immersion
clusters.authorized_action_scope: close room door during play; warn user after 2 hours
clusters.rationale: Single hypothetical rule, single owner; failure meaning not explicit in text (both coders unknown).
clusters.boundary_notes: Door-closing conjunct kept with duration warning as jointly managing one play-session outcome; not merged with ambiance cluster since objective is boundary enforcement, not comfort.

clusters.objective: Support reliable waking and comfortable informed morning routines.
clusters.meaningful_failure: oversleeping when alarm not switched off; cold bathroom during morning shower
clusters.authorized_action_scope: raise shutters and switch on light when alarm is not turned off; heat bathroom and deliver news during morning shower window
clusters.rationale: Two owners converge on automated morning support (wake-up fallback, shower comfort) but within one study cluster and hypothetical only; below candidate threshold of three owners.
clusters.boundary_notes: Wake-up fallback (r116) and shower comfort (r011) are arguably distinct outcomes; merged narrowly under daily-morning-support because both are recurring morning-time comfort/reliability outcomes. Could be split without losing coverage. Not merged with ambiance cluster: time-of-day routine vs activity-conditioned.
coding_disagreements: r011 temporal_scope: luna=event_conditioned, kimi=recurring; r116 failure_meaning: luna=security_failure, kimi=unknown (luna's security_failure label appears mistaken for a wake-up rule)

clusters.objective: Ensure kitchen ventilation runs while cooking on the hob.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: switch on extractor hood when hob is in use
clusters.rationale: Single hypothetical rule, single owner; both coders compatible_only, failure meaning unknown.
clusters.boundary_notes: Adjacent to indoor_air_quality (u20_r119) but not merged: hood-on-hob is routine ventilation, smoke-response is air-quality remediation of a detected contaminant.

clusters.meaningful_failure: plants drying out below viable soil humidity
clusters.authorized_action_scope: start irrigation when pot soil humidity drops below 30%
clusters.rationale: Single hypothetical rule, single owner; no cross-owner convergence.
clusters.boundary_notes: Kept separate from pet_care_provisioning: plant hydration vs animal care have different beneficiaries and failure modes despite surface similarity.
coding_disagreements: beneficiary: luna=unknown, kimi=household; failure_meaning: luna=discomfort, kimi=unknown

clusters.objective: Maintain breathable indoor air when smoke is detected.
clusters.meaningful_failure: smoke persisting indoors with closed windows
clusters.authorized_action_scope: open windows or switch on air purification when smoke detected and windows closed
clusters.rationale: Single hypothetical rule, single owner; both coders compatible_only.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with cooking_ventilation: contaminant-triggered remediation vs appliance-coupled routine ventilation.

clusters.objective: Prevent devices running unattended after the household leaves.
clusters.meaningful_failure: TV or similar device left on in an empty home
clusters.authorized_action_scope: turn off TV and notify user when leaving and no motion detected
clusters.rationale: Single hypothetical rule, single owner; shutoff and notification jointly manage one outcome (unattended device) so kept compound.
clusters.boundary_notes: Adjacent to away_home_security_monitoring in trigger (departure/emptiness) but objective is energy/device management, not surveillance; not merged.

excluded_groups.reason: Opaque SmartThings corpus sequence with unknown authorship, trigger/action roles, purpose, beneficiary, and active status; no support for any responsibility claim. Excluded as mechanism-only per protocol; preserved in evidence ledger.

coverage_check.note: All evidence is hypothetical participant-authored rules (compatible_only from both coders) confined to one study cluster, plus one mechanism-only corpus record; no cluster meets direct, convergent, or candidate thresholds, so all clusters are proposed as excluded_from_responsibility_catalog pending further evidence.
